manual_or_upload.label: Netflix viewing activity export
manual_or_upload.description: Request your Netflix viewing activity from netflix.com/account/getmyinfo (up to 30 days to prepare), then upload ViewingActivity.csv or the full export .zip here.

acquisition_methods.label: Request your export from Netflix
acquisition_methods.detail: Go to netflix.com/account/getmyinfo and request an export. Netflix emails you when it's ready (up to 30 days).

acquisition_methods.label: Upload the export archive or CSV
acquisition_methods.detail: Upload the .zip Netflix sends you directly, or extract it yourself and upload just CONTENT_INTERACTION/ViewingActivity.csv.

manual_or_upload.help_text: Netflix does not expose viewing history through an account API or OAuth grant. This source imports the owner-requested official export.
manual_or_upload.large_file_fallback: The full Netflix export archive can include many CSVs beyond viewing history; if the .zip exceeds the upload limit, extract it yourself and upload just CONTENT_INTERACTION/ViewingActivity.csv, or use the server import-folder handoff.
validation_expectations: Detected ViewingActivity.csv, either standalone or inside the official export zip
Duplicate, empty, unsupported, or too-large file status

refresh_policy.rationale: Netflix official export (getmyinfo) requires manual download from netflix.com/account/getmyinfo. The export takes up to 30 days and must be extracted locally. No automated refresh path exists.

streams.name: viewing_activity
streams.description: Netflix viewing activity from official export.

display.label: Your Netflix viewing history
display.detail: Titles watched with timestamp, device type, and watch duration percent. Parsed from ViewingActivity.csv in the Netflix export bundle.
